title: Analytics
description: Understand traffic and application activity without identifying visitors.
no_properties: Create a property to start measuring traffic. Tracking stays off until you enable it.
name: Name
origins_help: One full origin per line, for example https://example.com.
routes_help: One path per line. Use :id for one variable segment, for example /records/:id. Unlisted routes are excluded.
events_help: One event per line: download: format, category. Leave empty to collect pageviews only.
utm_help: Choose only the campaign values you want to keep. Other query parameters are discarded.
enabled_help: Tracking is off by default. Public pages and application usage use separate properties.
delete_description: This permanently deletes the property and all its collected traffic and events.
error: Analytics could not be loaded. Try again.
estimates: Visitors are daily estimates. Sessions reset after 30 minutes of inactivity or at UTC midnight.
recent_help: Last five minutes; updates every 30 seconds while this page is visible.
geo_approximate: Locations are approximate and based on network addresses, not device GPS.
geo_unavailable: Location database unavailable. Activity is still collected with unknown locations.
setup_help: The demo host tracks matching routes once this property is enabled. Other hosts can install the analytics host adapter and send approved custom events with track(name, properties).
event_format_error: Use one event per line: event: property, property.
